OCR on frame_6.50.png reads "A(□) = 10" at bbox [312, 512, 686, 562] with average detection confidence 0.9750, so the given premise is that each rectangle has area 10 square units.

For the answer-critical frame, the frame-level chart_analyzer result on frame_6.50.png says "The bottom-left rectangle is shaded with a dark fill, while the top-right rectangle is outlined but not shaded," and its query_response says the shaded region is the bottom-left rectangle. Since the shaded region at 6.5s is one whole rectangle, and OCR reports each rectangle has area 10 square units, the shaded area is 10 square units.
Therefore the correct option is C, 10 sq units.
